name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  dsimp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars]
  intro x
  induction post <;>
    simp only [substOld, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars,
      List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at *
  case app =>
    split
    · split
      · exact fun h => Or.inr (List.mem_singleton.mp h)
      · exact fun h => Or.inl (List.mem_append.mp h)
    · simp only [Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append]
      grind
  all_goals grind only

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a ⊆ c) (k : b ⊆ d) :
      a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d :=
    List.append_subset.mpr
      ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h, List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ k⟩
  intro h
  induction h with
  | app hfn he hn ihfn ihe =>
    unfold extractOldExprVars
    split
    · exact List.Subset.refl _
    · next hf =>
      cases hn .oldPred
      assumption
    · exact app ihfn ihe
  | _ => repeat first | assumption | exact List.nil_subset _ | apply app

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  simp only [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext a
  by_contra ha
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f a) hf continuous_const
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f a, f a⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (fun h => ha (inner_self_eq_zero'.mp h.symm))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp
    (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) a hp
  let b : ContDiffBump a := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have hc' := b.continuous.mul hc
  have hz := hg (fun x => b x • f a) (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨b.contDiff, b.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  refine ne_of_gt (integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero (x := a) hc'
    (hc'.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport b.hasCompactSupport.mul_right) ?_ ?_) hz
  · intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.ball a r
    · exact mul_nonneg b.nonneg (hball hx).le
    · simp only [Pi.mul_apply, Pi.zero_apply, b.zero_of_le_dist (le_of_not_gt hx), zero_mul, le_refl]
  · exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (b.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)))
      (ne_of_gt hp)

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs := fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd := fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBc := fun j => magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A
    (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)
  have hBt := fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBc j) x
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (c := 𝓕.c)
    (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have hcurl := fun j => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (i := j) (hBc j) t x
  simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)),
    fun j => Space.fun_deriv_sub (u := j) _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i),
    fun j => Space.deriv_commute (u := j) (v := i) _ (hEs j)] at hcurl
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt] at hg
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
    fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t).differentiableAt,
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply] at hg
  simp only [← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
      (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub
    ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
    (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
    fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
    fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
  simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, _root_.sum_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Time.deriv_eq, hcurl, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  simp [mul_sub, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_assoc, mul_left_comm, mul_comm]

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  induction Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b using Submodule.span_induction
  case' mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    induction Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a using Submodule.span_induction
    case mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
      let l1 := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
          ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel)) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs')
      let l2 := (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) φs) ++
        (List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
          ((φs' ++ φs).insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel))
      have hs (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp)
          (hl : ∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) :
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ l ++ φs))) =
            ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι (ofCrAnListF l) * ι (ofCrAnListF l2) := by
        rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_eq_list _ φ _ _ _ hl]
        simp only [l1, l2, ofCrAnListF_append, map_mul, mul_assoc]
      have hs1 := hs [φ, ψ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      have hs2 := hs [ψ, φ] (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
      simp only [List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at hs1 hs2
      trans crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (ι (ofCrAnListF l1) * ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ι (ofCrAnListF l2))
      · rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
          ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
        simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
          ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
          map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, smul_sub]
        rw [hs1, hs2, ← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
        rw [smul_comm]
      · rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp
          (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
        have hs0 := hs [] (by simp)
        simp only [List.append_nil, ofCrAnListF_nil, map_one, mul_one] at hs0
        rw [← hs0]
        by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
        · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
        · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign,
            Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_not.mp hq).symm,
            ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  all_goals simp only [*, zero_mul, mul_zero, map_zero,
    add_mul, mul_add, map_add, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => simpa using mem
  case abs | tabs => left; constructor; assumption
  case sub ih => exact ih rfl lc
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with vl | ⟨t', red⟩
    · have := ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1
      grind only [→ canonical_form_abs, → Value.lc, → Red.abs, → Red.appᵣ vl]
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 red⟩
  case tapp d s ih =>
    have := ih rfl d.wf.2.1
    have := s.wf.2.1.lc
    grind only [→ canonical_form_tabs, → Value.lc, → Red.tapp, → Red.tabs]
  case let' d _ ih _ =>
    have h := body_let.mp lc
    have := ih rfl d.wf.2.1
    grind only [→ Red.let_body, → Red.let_bind]
  case inl d _ ih | inr d _ ih =>
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨_, v⟩ <;> [left; right] <;>
      repeat' first | assumption | constructor
  case case d _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨_, h₂, h₃⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl d.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨t', red⟩
    · obtain ⟨b, rfl | rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v <;> cases v <;>
        solve_by_elim [Exists.intro, Red.case_inl, Red.case_inr]
    · exact ⟨_, .case red h₂ h₃⟩

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case' par.red_I | par.red_K | par.red_S => apply symm
  case red_I.par hc ha | par.red_I ha _ hc _ =>
    obtain rfl := I_irreducible _ hc
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hb | par.red_K hb _ ha _ =>
    obtain ⟨c, h, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, h, .red_K _ _⟩
  case red_S.par hab hc | par.red_S hc _ a b hab _ =>
    obtain ⟨a', b', ha, hb, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hab
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par ha hc) (.par hb hc), .red_S _ _ _⟩
  case par.par ha hb iha ihb a' b' ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨a, ha₁, ha₂⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨b, hb₁, hb₂⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par ha₁ hb₁, .par ha₂ hb₂⟩
  all_goals
    refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  constructor <;> intro u ht <;> cases hr <;> rename_i h
  case' left.choice | right.choice =>
    cases ht <;> rename_i ht
    case choiceR =>
      exact ⟨u, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  all_goals
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hb⟩ := (by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht)
    refine ⟨v, ?_, ChoiceBisim.bisim hb⟩
    first | exact hv | exact Tr.choiceL hv

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  have ha : (2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) - 2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps))) *
      2 ^ steps = 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - i.val) - 2 ^ (ℓ - i.val) := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add]
    congr 2 <;> omega
  let C := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩
  obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (Set.image_nonempty.mpr
    Set.univ_nonempty :
    ((fun g : C => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) ''
      Set.univ).Nonempty)
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let Q := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := ⟨i, i.isLt.trans (lt_of_add_right_lt h_ℓ_add_R_rate)⟩) (steps := steps)
    (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps)
  have hd : hammingDist f g ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g.val x) ⊆
        Finset.image₂ Q Y.toFinset Finset.univ := by
      intro x hx
      exact Finset.mem_image₂.mpr
        ⟨iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x,
          Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩,
          pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_of_lt i.isLt⟩) (steps := steps)
            (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x), Finset.mem_univ _,
          (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card']
    apply (Finset.card_le_card hs).trans
    simpa only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin] using
      Finset.card_image₂_le Q Y.toFinset Finset.univ
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - (i.val + steps)) -
      2 ^ (ℓ - (i.val + steps)) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    rw [show Y.ncard = _ from hg]
    exact ENat.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g g.property) 2)
  apply ENat.coe_lt_coe.2
  have := (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans
    (by simpa only [← mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb)
  rw [ha] at this
  exact Nat.lt_succ_of_le this

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) :
      P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega)
      (fiberMap k)
    have g := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩
    have hq := congrArg Subtype.val (h.symm.trans g.symm)
    dsimp only at hq
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hq, Polynomial.eval_mul,
    Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀, P₁]
  have hd : (fiberMap 1).val - (fiberMap 0).val = 1 := by
    dsimp only [fiberMap]
    rw [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1,
      qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis,
    add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  dsimp only [fold, f_i_plus_1, f_i]
  rw [he 0, he 1]
  calc
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp hd]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, eval_finset_sum, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C, sum_mul, oddRefinement,
    ← sum_add_distrib, intermediateEvaluationPoly, P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro n hn
  induction n, hn using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
      intro u hp
      simp only [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) u,
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      rw [← hu]
      exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
  | succ n hn ih =>
      intro u hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ n) Nat.one_le_two_pow
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e ?_)
      · apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
        intro r hr
        exact ih _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hr).2
      · simp only [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at hp
        rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun]
        assumption

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hs := Set.finite_Icc B T
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := (hs.prod (hs.prod (hs.prod hs))).exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (by intro n; exact ⟨hb n, hb (n+1), hb (n+2), hb (n+3)⟩)
  have h : ∀ m, f (i + m) = f (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => exact he
    | succ m ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih
      rcases ih with ⟨h0, h1, h2, h3⟩
      refine Prod.ext h1 (Prod.ext h2 (Prod.ext h3 ?_))
      change u (i+m+4) = u (j+m+4)
      apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
      rw [(hu (i+m+4) (Nat.le_add_left 4 _)).1, (hu (j+m+4) (Nat.le_add_left 4 _)).1]
      simp only [ Nat.reduceSubDiff, Nat.add_zero, h0, h1, h2, h3]
  refine ⟨i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  simpa only [f, Nat.add_sub_of_le hn, show j+(n-i) = n+(j-i) by omega] using
    (congrArg Prod.fst (h (n-i))).symm

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hc : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bijective compl compl_bijective
    simp only [Finset.mem_compl]
    grind
  have ht := P.card_add_card_compl
  rw [ Fintype.card_set,
    ← pow_sub_one_mul Fintype.card_ne_zero] at ht
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have hs (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (b i - a i) * 10 ^ i.val + digits_to_num a := by
    convert ((hrelation a b).mp h).2 i using 1
    apply eq_sub_iff_add_eq.mp
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, ← sub_mul,
      Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  intro d e f h i
  have hd := hs d e h.1
  have ht := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hd j)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul,
    Nat.cast_ofNat, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at ht
  have hc : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  apply (hc.pow_right (n := i.val)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub ht (dvd_add (hd i) (hs e f h.2 i)))
    (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
